headline: Type a goal. HIVE finds the missing step, checks it, admits it and reuses it.
summary: One connected run of the learning loop on one Windows PC: goal -> contract -> typed plan -> gap -> one local-model proposal -> independent evaluator 24/24 -> signed admission -> reuse on unused real inputs after restart with zero model calls. The step ties a simple scripted baseline: mechanism, not advantage.
limitations: One workload, one model; ties the scripted baseline; admission trust = one Windows user; rollback proven by test fixture only; not Level A, Level B or neural learning.
